how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-deathknell-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8:obj:0: Deliver the Nondescript Letter to ⟦E1⟧ Renee in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8:details:0: Hey, mate! Do a favor for a young man who's been fighting more than his fair share of mindless zombies and spiders?
rows.quest:8:details:1: BI got this here letter that needs to go to ⟦E3⟧... to an innkeeper named Renee something-or-other. Don't really matter none what her last name is.
rows.quest:8:details:2: BAnyway, it's a nice cozy little place full of victims of the plague trying to make their way in the world. And it be a great spot for you to rest too if the need arises. You should check it out... you do and I'll pay you well.
rows.quest:8:completion:0: Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.
rows.quest:8:completion:1: BWhat? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?
rows.quest:8:completion:2: BWell, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!
rows.quest:8:completion:3: BCome back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.
rows.quest:8:completion:4: BNext thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.
rows.quest:363:details:0: About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.
rows.quest:363:details:1: BI am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.
rows.quest:363:details:2: BSpeak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
rows.quest:363:completion:0: Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...
rows.quest:363:completion:1: BI see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.
rows.quest:363:completion:2: BWe have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
rows.quest:364:obj:0: Shadow Priest Sarvis wants you to kill 8 Mindless Zombies and 8 Wretched Zombies.
rows.quest:364:details:0: We ⟦E4⟧ are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the undead, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.
rows.quest:364:details:1: BThe northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
rows.quest:364:completion:0: It is unfortunate that the Scourge cannot be brought into the fold, their large numbers would be useful in the battles ahead.
rows.quest:364:completion:1: BBut they will not join us, so we have no choice but to destroy them.
rows.quest:376:obj:0: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.
rows.quest:376:details:0: My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need.
rows.quest:376:details:1: BFrom the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
rows.quest:376:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦1⟧. This armor should help you out.
rows.quest:376:completion:1: BHopefully, it should do you more good than the last one to wear it...
rows.quest:380:obj:0: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.
rows.quest:380:details:0: One of our greatest struggles is obtaining the natural resources we need to survive. Gold was scarce even in the height of the ⟦E5⟧'s power.
rows.quest:380:details:1: BThere is a gold mine to the northwest that has been overrun with spiders. We need gold from the mine, but we can't very well get it while the spiders are crawling around in there. I've not much manpower to commit to the task, so we'll just have to do it little by little.
rows.quest:380:details:2: BGet up there and see what you can do for us, ⟦2⟧.
rows.quest:380:completion:0: Hmm, well, it's a start. It'll take a few weeks or months to fully clean out the infestation. After that, we'll have to get down there with some torches to burn away the webbing.
rows.quest:380:completion:1: BYou've done your duty well, ⟦3⟧, I'm sure I can find something else for you to do.
rows.quest:381:obj:0: Bring Executor Arren 12 ⟦E6⟧ Armbands from ⟦E6⟧ Converts and ⟦E6⟧ Initiates.
rows.quest:381:details:0: You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts. We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.
rows.quest:381:details:1: BMy scouts have reported that a detachment of the ⟦E7⟧ is setting up a camp southeast of here. The ⟦E7⟧ is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every undead--Lich King's Scourge or no--is destroyed. We must strike first!
rows.quest:381:details:2: BBe careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.
rows.quest:381:completion:0: If only they listened to reason, eh, ⟦4⟧? Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... ha!
rows.quest:382:obj:0: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.
rows.quest:382:details:0: Reports from my superiors in ⟦E3⟧ indicate that an agent of the ⟦E7⟧ was dispatched from the ⟦E6⟧ Monastery and sent here to Deathknell. According to the reports, the messenger possesses important information on his person. I do not have further details, but whatever it is, we must have it!
rows.quest:382:details:1: BYou're the most qualified person I have to send, ⟦5⟧. Find that messenger and bring me whatever information you can find.
rows.quest:382:completion:0: Hmm... Let's see what you've got...
rows.quest:382:completion:1: B<He begins to rifle through the documents you recovered.>
rows.quest:382:completion:2: BSome news of their exploits against us... Worthless. Scouting reports... New orders, "Continue to build up a camp near the ruined city..." Nothing we didn't know already... Ah, what's this? A map of the dispositions of some of their field commanders and agents! We can use this.
rows.quest:383:obj:0: Deliver the ⟦E7⟧ Documents to Executor Zygand in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:383:details:0: These will need to be taken to my superior, Executor Zygand, in ⟦E3⟧. With this information, we'll be able to deal a decisive blow to the ⟦E7⟧. Your services have been useful here in Deathknell, but I need someone to deliver this to Zygand, and I believe he'll be able to find you more appropriate work.
rows.quest:383:details:1: BTake the road north out of Deathknell. Soon after entering Tirisfal proper, you'll hit a crossroads. Take the eastern fork, and keep going east. You'll pass Cold Hearth Manor along the way.
rows.quest:383:completion:0: Yes, this is very good. You've done well in obtaining this information, ⟦6⟧. Hmm... names of the officers in the ⟦E2⟧...
rows.quest:383:completion:1: BImagine the blow we could deal to the morale of those bloody zealots if we were to kill their leaders in one swift strike.
rows.quest:590:details:2: BYou want money? I don't owe you any money.
rows.quest:590:details:3: BLetter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... let's do this! Owe you any money...
rows.quest:590:completion:1: BThought you'd be easy prey, ⟦7⟧. Got me good, you did.
rows.quest:590:completion:2: BHere's the coin I promised... not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.
rows.quest:3901:obj:0: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
rows.quest:3901:details:0: You've shown your potential to the ⟦E4⟧ under normal circumstances ⟦8⟧ - now let's see you under pressure.
rows.quest:3901:details:1: BThe Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far. Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the ⟦E4⟧. Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
rows.quest:3901:completion:0: I am finished with you, ⟦9⟧ - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given. Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.
rows.quest:3901:completion:1: BTake these and be on your way. You have much to accomplish, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:3902:obj:0: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
rows.quest:3902:details:0: You there! If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!
rows.quest:3902:details:1: BWe need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment. Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes. We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!
rows.quest:3902:details:2: BWell get to work, you miserable bag of bones! I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.
rows.quest:3902:completion:0: Great work ⟦11⟧, I knew you weren't useless. Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.
rows.quest:5847:obj:0: Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.
rows.quest:5847:details:0: Welcome to the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5847:details:1: BAs special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory.
rows.quest:5847:details:2: BThanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
rows.quest:5847:completion:0: You are indeed a special hero, ⟦12⟧. We welcome you to the world of ⟦E9⟧, and offer you one of these unique gifts!
rows.quest:6395:obj:0: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.
rows.quest:6395:details:0: My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks.
rows.quest:6395:details:1: BMarla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband. So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel.
rows.quest:6395:details:2: BSamuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell. Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.
rows.quest:6395:completion:0: You have done a good deed today, ⟦13⟧. Although our struggle against the Scourge continues, let us hope that Marla and Samuel will find peace together in their final resting place.
